# Tark | तर्क — Competitive Exam Testing Arena & AI Daily Intelligence

> Sterile, analytical testing arena and daily UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE) and State Public Service Commissions policy intelligence engine. Free of commercial noise, advertisements, and clickbait.

Tark delivers deterministic examination simulations calibrated with strict negative marking (+2.00 / -0.66) and verified policy intelligence distilled directly from the Press Information Bureau (PIB), Union Cabinet decisions, Reserve Bank of India (RBI), and PRS Legislative Research.

## Core Intelligence & Knowledge Hubs

- [Daily UPSC Current Affairs & Policy Signal](https://tark.live/intelligence): Continuous autonomous distillation of high-impact government policy notifications, statutory bills, and multilateral agreements categorized by UPSC Prelims & Mains General Studies (GS 1, 2, 3, 4).
- [Daily PIB Curated Edition](https://tark.live/daily-edition): Finite, date-wise verified digest of high-yield government policy releases with prelims key facts and mains hooks.
- [PRS Legislative Vault](https://tark.live/prs): Statutory analysis and deep legislative breakdowns of Parliamentary Bills and Acts.
- [25-Year UPSC Question Observatory](https://tark.live/observatory): Deep cognitive matrix of two and a half decades of UPSC Civil Services Prelims questions categorized by theme, cognitive level, and syllabus linkage.
- [Competitive Test Arena](https://tark.live/arena): Timed examination simulator with zero-trust server-side grading and diagnostic autopsies.
- [The Tark Manifesto](https://tark.live/manifesto): Educational philosophy, methodology on eliminating noise in competitive civil services preparation, and editorial fact-checking protocols.

## Feeds & Machine Readability

- [XML Sitemap](https://tark.live/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable index of all 1,500+ intelligence articles and dossiers.
- [Google News Sitemap](https://tark.live/sitemap-news.xml): Fresh policy wire dispatches published within the last 48 hours.
- [Robots Configuration](https://tark.live/robots.txt): Machine access permissions and crawler policies.

## Legal, Privacy & Compliance Charters

- [Privacy Policy & Data Governance Charter](https://tark.live/privacy): Statutory compliance under Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, zero-tracker architecture, and strict zero-data monetization pledge.
- [Terms of Service & Platform License Agreement](https://tark.live/terms): Institutional platform access terms, Section 52(1)(q) copyright compliance, and candidate covenant.
- [Refund, Cancellation & Seat Allocation Policy](https://tark.live/refund): 7-day unconditional refund window, 500 lifetime seat allocation rules, and consumer protections.
